conformance.reviewNote: Visually reviewed both PNG and JPG. Intended-use gate branches into equal practice/formal areas. Practice preserves four conditions; formal separates theory and practical requirements. Missing-condition fallback separate below. All shapes blank and unbordered; no certificate or approval-authority invention. All required strings, qualifications, and relationships are preserved in the incorporated source brief and any attached guide text. Reference can be rebuilt as editable HTML/CSS/inline SVG.
